correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed multipath face admissibility (at most one in/out arc per vertex and no directed cycle), the four-slot bound, augmented face vector f=(1,4n,6n²−4n,4n(n−1)²,n(n−1)²(n−2)), and the sequential pivot acyclicity argument. Independently enumerated exact f-vectors for n=5,6,9: 711,1417,6823 faces; for n=9 the specified six-leaf pivots match every face with ≤3 arcs, leaving 2143 four-arc faces. An arbitrary such low face uses ≤3 outer leaves, so relabeling these as leaves 6,7,8 preserves every fixed first-six-leaf pivot incidence and its staged matched status, proving the n=9 result for all n≥6. The n=5 pivot list leaves one critical 2-cell (2,5,11) and 32 critical 3-cells; independently recomputed signed integral Morse boundary frequency (+2:11, −2:10, 0:11), gcd 2. Integral CW attaching-degree classification proves Moore summand plus 31 free 3-spheres. For n≥6 only critical 3-cells remain after restoring a 0-cell, giving sphere wedges, not merely field homology.
residual_risks: Universal inference depends on exact stated combinatorial locality and pivot list; n=9 alone without that relabeling would not prove n≥6.
